name: mcp-wp
description: Manage a WordPress site from Claude: content, taxonomies, media, users, comments and plugins.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to a WordPress site through the REST API with an Application Password. Create, edit and find posts, pages and custom post types (including targeted partial edits and URL lookup), manage categories, tags and custom taxonomies, media, users, comments and plugins, and search the WordPress.org plugin directory. WordPress 5.6+ is needed for Application Passwords.

wordpress_url.title: WordPress URL
wordpress_url.description: Address of the site, e.g. https://www.example.com (the REST API path is added automatically).

wordpress_username.title: Username
wordpress_username.description: WordPress user that owns the Application Password.

wordpress_app_password.title: Application Password
wordpress_app_password.description: Users → Profile → Application Passwords in the WordPress admin. Not your login password.

log_level.title: Log level
log_level.description: Logs go to the Claude Desktop MCP log: error, info or debug.

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: Lists content of any type (posts, pages, or custom post types) with filtering and pagination
